mapper.select: SELECT PLAN_YM AS "yearMonth", SALES_TGT_AMT AS "revenueTarget", OPRT_PRFT_TGT_AMT AS "operatingProfitTarget" FROM TB_FI_BIZ_PLAN WHERE PART_ID = 'ALL' AND PLAN_YM BETWEEN (CAST(#{year} AS text) || '01') AND (CAST(#{year} AS text) || '12') ORDER BY PLAN_YM
mapper.update: LOCK TABLE TB_FI_BIZ_PLAN, TB_CL_CLOSE IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_FI_BIZ_PLAN(PLAN_YM, PART_ID, SALES_TGT_AMT, OPRT_PRFT_TGT_AMT, UPLD_ID, REG_USER_ID, REG_DTTM) VALUES(#{yearMonth}, 'ALL', #{revenueTarget}, #{operatingProfitTarget}, #{uploadId}, #{userId}, clock_timestamp()) ON CONFLICT (PLAN_YM, PART_ID) DO UPDATE SET SALES_TGT_AMT = EXCLUDED.SALES_TGT_AMT, OPRT_PRFT_TGT_AMT = EXCLUDED.OPRT_PRFT_TGT_AMT, UPLD_ID = EXCLUDED.UPLD_ID, MOD_USER_ID = #{userId}, MOD_DTTM = clock_timestamp()
